title: Costume 솔로 #156 · hourglass bombshell · 메두사 · 힙 팝 · 가을 단풍길 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long wavy golden blonde hair — wearing a minimal Medusa costume of a tiny emerald-green snakeskin-scale top of two small opaque cups with gold coiled-serpent trim, a tiny low-rise opaque emerald snakeskin-scale bottom with a gold serpent clasp, a crown of living-looking green snakes rising from her hair, golden serpent armbands coiled around both upper arms and a gold serpent anklet, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of iridescent emerald-green snakeskin, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in iridescent emerald-green snakeskin with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
